summary: D3-D4 Pass D: review gate + promote gate (queue / user apply)
description: Nodes D3 (review) + D4 (promote) — both GATES. D3: judge staged rows against the seven rubric codes; on a CLUSTER of the same code, revise the prompt template and regenerate rather than rejecting rows one by one (template is the converging unit). Queue only. D4 (promote): user apply gate -> work_dossiers + summary_nodes. Never self-promote. DONE: D3 decisions queued / template converged; promotion handed to the user.
